target.title: test: speed up Crabbox wrapper coverage
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`test/scripts/crabbox-wrapper.test.ts` was the largest remaining tooling test file, taking 15.975 seconds of Linux file time. The harness recreated identical fake Git executables for nearly every case, while three integration cases consumed production-scale timeout windows.

Related: #57266

## Why This Change Was Made

- Cache fake Git fixture directories by their exact response map.
- Accelerate time only inside spawned wrapper test processes, preserving real timeout and child-tree escalation branches without changing production code or adding runtime configuration.
- Remove one sparse changed-gate case with identical inputs and assertions that were a strict subset of the preceding case.
- Pass preload paths as separate Node argv entries for paths containing spaces.

## User Impact

No runtime behavior changes. The Crabbox wrapper suite is faster and uses less local peak memory while preserving all distinct behavior coverage.

## Evidence

- Audited all 188 original cases; 187 distinct cases remain.
- Local focused report: 51.240s to 21.152s wall, 48.061s to 18.659s file time, 309.1MB to 284.2MB max RSS.
- Linux focused report: 15.975s to 5.865s file time; 187 tests. Testbox `tbx_01kwpmy0y2z5zqae2tdfjth3nn`, Actions run 28707658023.
- `pnpm format:check -- test/scripts/crabbox-wrapper.test.ts`
- `pnpm test:changed`: 187 passed.
- Testbox `pnpm check:changed`: `tbx_01kwpn03xqf3n95mxxkennpx4w`, Actions run 28707686288.
- Autoreview clean after one accepted portability fix: no accepted or actionable findings (0.97).
